                  </span> <!----></div></div> <div style="flex:1;" data-v-61fb5e44=""></div> <!----> <!----></div> <!----> <!----> <!----> <!----> <div id="article-root" itemprop="articleBody" class="main" data-v-61fb5e44=""><div class="article-viewer markdown-body result"><p>如果你正在做<strong>官网开发</strong>，还在辛苦的手动实现那些动画特效，那今天推荐的这个库，至少让你提前<code>4小时</code>开始摸鱼!</p>
<p>以前，面对设计师的那些炫酷动画，实现起来是最耗头发的；产品经理还时不时的说一下，这效果不好看，我要的是五彩斑斓的黑！</p>
<p>还抱着 Element UI + Animate.css 在那里辛苦调试，苦苦思考好好的效果怎么到了 safari 就变形了呢 ？</p>
<p>现如今，时代变了！</p>
<h2 data-id="heading-0">什么是 Inspira UI</h2>
<p><strong>Inspira UI</strong> 是专门为 <strong>Vue3/Nuxt</strong> 开发的可复用的动画组件集合。</p>
<p><img src="https://p9-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/bf5d729617f4455eb7371254980903f9~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5a2m5LuA5LmI5YmN56uv:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1767001933&amp;x-signature=rp7YM4ldyvD0EYWqVWdM2mSuIAs%3D" alt="" loading="lazy"></p>
<ul>
<li>完全免费和开源</li>
<li>完美支持 <code>vue3</code>/<code>Nuxt3</code></li>
<li>包括<code>按钮</code>、<code>输入框</code>、<code>背景</code>、<code>卡片</code>、<code>设备模拟</code>、<code>光标</code>、<code>2D/3D效果</code>等<code>120+</code> 个特效组件</li>
<li>样式基于 <code>TailwindCSS</code></li>
<li>动画使用 <code>motion-v</code>、<code>gsap</code> 实现</li>
<li>对移动设备特别优化</li>
</ul>
<p>来欣赏一下效果：</p>
<p><img src="https://p9-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/ff98331d692249c8a68f87801f7a9854~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5a2m5LuA5LmI5YmN56uv:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1767001933&amp;x-signature=qM6ylaL64ee2RjZV8wSiVMqgiTY%3D" alt="视频文字" loading="lazy"></p>

<p>走马灯</p>
<p><img src="https://p9-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/b2081c995495424fab5f120063c6988c~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5a2m5LuA5LmI5YmN56uv:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1767001933&amp;x-signature=WE%2BazS9IOrKfzhXI5nG60dM0vP0%3D" alt="spline" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>spline</p>
<h2 data-id="heading-1">Inspira UI 的优势</h2>
<h3 data-id="heading-2">1.兼顾视觉与功能</h3>
<p>以**「轻量动效组件库」<strong>为定位，核心组件覆盖基础 UI（按钮、输入框等）和模块（3D 交互、动态背景等），所有组件均内置</strong>微交互**设计。动效无需额外开发完美适配企业官网、电商页面等需视觉增强的场景，实现 “拿即用” 的开发体验。</p>
<p><img src="https://p9-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/aec8d78118394acca812da784c186c9b~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5a2m5LuA5LmI5YmN56uv:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1767001933&amp;x-signature=QLgzkuWf6azin6c2kPas536yVN8%3D" alt="Liquid Logo" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>Liquid Logo</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-3">2.基于Tailwind CSS V4</h3>
<p>底层基于 Tailwind CSS 构建组件基础样式，确保原子类叠加的灵活性；支持浅色、深色模式一键切换；支持 ypeScript，所有组件与 API 均提供完整类型定义。</p>
<p><img src="https://p9-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/d02d678ffd4b4067bda28d0878292b32~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5a2m5LuA5LmI5YmN56uv:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1767001933&amp;x-signature=oGZrnb6cY79SDa%2FupNOBld217GU%3D" alt="浅色模式" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>浅色模式</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-4">3.深度兼容 Vue/Nuxt 生态，性能提升</h3>
<p>无论是 Vue 单页应用还是 Nuxt 服务端渲染项目，都能无缝融入现有技术栈，降低开发者的学习与迁移成本。</p>
<p>同时基于 Vue 3.4+ 新增的 <code>defineModel </code>与 <code>watchEffect </code>语法重构，减少了至少 30% 的响应式依赖开销;</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-5">4.多端性能优化</h3>
<p>对于 3D 组件，在支持 WebGPU 的浏览器中，渲染帧率较旧版 WebGL 提升 2-3 倍.</p>
<p>而对于移动端设备、低配置设备会自动调节动效帧率，性能大大提高；同时，对所有组件做了 “懒加载 + 预渲染” 优化，首屏加载速度较旧版提升 35%</p>
<h2 data-id="heading-6">如何使用？</h2>
<p>Inspira UI 官方文档支持中文，写的也很接地气，通俗易懂 5 分钟就能上手！</p>
<ul>
<li>安装依赖</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="hljs language-shell" lang="shell">    #&nbsp;安装&nbsp;tainlwind
    pnpm&nbsp;install&nbsp;tailwindcss&nbsp;@tailwindcss/vite

    #&nbsp;安装&nbsp;tailwindcss&nbsp;库和实用工具
    pnpm&nbsp;install&nbsp;-D&nbsp;clsx&nbsp;tailwind-merge&nbsp;class-variance-authority&nbsp;tw-animate-css

    #&nbsp;安装&nbsp;VueUse&nbsp;和其他支持库
    pnpm&nbsp;install&nbsp;@vueuse/core&nbsp;motion-v
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>配置 vite</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js">    <span class="hljs-keyword">import</span>&nbsp;{&nbsp;defineConfig&nbsp;}&nbsp;<span class="hljs-keyword">from</span>&nbsp;<span class="hljs-string">'vite'</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">import</span>&nbsp;tailwindcss&nbsp;<span class="hljs-keyword">from</span>&nbsp;<span class="hljs-string">'@tailwindcss/vite'</span>

    <span class="hljs-keyword">export</span>&nbsp;<span class="hljs-keyword">default</span>&nbsp;<span class="hljs-title function_">defineConfig</span>({
    &nbsp;&nbsp;<span class="hljs-attr">plugins</span>:&nbsp;\[
    &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<span class="hljs-title function_">tailwindcss</span>(),
    &nbsp;&nbsp;],
    })
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>配置主题</li>
</ul>
<p>可以根据需要自由配置主题色。</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-css" lang="css">    <span class="hljs-keyword">@import</span>&nbsp;tailwindcss;
    <span class="hljs-keyword">@import</span>&nbsp;tw-animate-css;
    <span class="hljs-keyword">@custom-variant</span>&nbsp;dark&nbsp;(&amp;:is(.dark&nbsp;*));

    <span class="hljs-selector-pseudo">:root</span>&nbsp;{
    &nbsp;&nbsp;<span class="hljs-attr">--card</span>:&nbsp;<span class="hljs-built_in">oklch</span>(<span class="hljs-number">1</span>&nbsp;<span class="hljs-number">0</span>&nbsp;<span class="hljs-number">0</span>);
    &nbsp;&nbsp;<span class="hljs-attr">--card-foreground</span>:&nbsp;<span class="hljs-built_in">oklch</span>(<span class="hljs-number">0.141</span>&nbsp;<span class="hljs-number">0.005</span>&nbsp;<span class="hljs-number">285.823</span>);
    }
    <span class="hljs-selector-class">.dark</span>&nbsp;{
    &nbsp;&nbsp;<span class="hljs-attr">--background</span>:&nbsp;<span class="hljs-built_in">oklch</span>(<span class="hljs-number">0.141</span>&nbsp;<span class="hljs-number">0.005</span>&nbsp;<span class="hljs-number">285.823</span>);
    &nbsp;&nbsp;<span class="hljs-attr">--foreground</span>:&nbsp;<span class="hljs-built_in">oklch</span>(<span class="hljs-number">0.985</span>&nbsp;<span class="hljs-number">0</span>&nbsp;<span class="hljs-number">0</span>);
    }
    <span class="hljs-keyword">@theme</span>&nbsp;inline&nbsp;{
    &nbsp;&nbsp;<span class="hljs-attr">--color-background</span>:&nbsp;<span class="hljs-built_in">var</span>(--background);
    }
    <span class="hljs-keyword">@layer</span>&nbsp;base&nbsp;{
    &nbsp;&nbsp;*&nbsp;{
    &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<span class="hljs-keyword">@apply</span>&nbsp;border-border&nbsp;outline-ring/<span class="hljs-number">50</span>;
    &nbsp;&nbsp;}
    &nbsp;&nbsp;<span class="hljs-selector-tag">body</span>&nbsp;{
    &nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;<span class="hljs-keyword">@apply</span>&nbsp;bg-background&nbsp;text-foreground;
    &nbsp;&nbsp;}
    }
    <span class="hljs-selector-tag">html</span>&nbsp;{
    &nbsp;&nbsp;<span class="hljs-attribute">color</span>-scheme:&nbsp;light&nbsp;dark;
    }
    <span class="hljs-selector-tag">html</span><span class="hljs-selector-class">.dark</span>&nbsp;{
    &nbsp;&nbsp;<span class="hljs-attribute">color</span>-scheme:&nbsp;dark;
    }
    <span class="hljs-selector-tag">html</span><span class="hljs-selector-class">.light</span>&nbsp;{
    &nbsp;&nbsp;<span class="hljs-attribute">color</span>-scheme:&nbsp;light;
    }
</code></pre>
<p>最后一步，可以复制源码或者通过 Cli 来安装。</p>
<ul>
<li>直接使用源码</li>
</ul>
<p>找到想要的组件，复制粘贴到自己的项目中即可。</p>
<p><img src="https://p9-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/e7358ea5a9064431833e56da1a6decf6~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5a2m5LuA5LmI5YmN56uv:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1767001933&amp;x-signature=pyjbkLQHTNwZw1t9zsYPergFJf4%3D" alt="" loading="lazy"></p>
<ul>
<li>通过 Cli 安装</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="hljs language-shell" lang="shell">    pnpm&nbsp;dlx&nbsp;shadcn-vue\@latest&nbsp;add&nbsp;"https://registry.inspira-ui.com/gradient-button.json&gt;"
</code></pre>
<p>然后，你就有了一个炫酷的按钮。</p>
<p><img src="https://p9-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/0432609fd16d498caf31aff3abead5fe~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5a2m5LuA5LmI5YmN56uv:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1767001933&amp;x-signature=CMRoQbEdcYXwfmKPZyU5gnpTb1s%3D" alt="Gradient Button 效果" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>Gradient Button 效果</p>
<h2 data-id="heading-7">最后</h2>
<p><code>Vue3</code>/<code>Nuxt3</code>开发者再也不用羡慕 <code>React</code>生态的 <code>Aceternity UI</code>、<code>Magic UI</code> 了。</p>
<p><code>Inspira UI</code> 直接填补了 vue3 生态中动效开发这一块的缺陷，可以将这些奇妙的设计应用在企业官网、特效开发中，大大节省开发成本。</p>
<p>让 Vue3 生态再一次得到加强，快去试试这个炫酷的项目把！</p>
